name: Missed connection rebooking
title: A missed connection, a sarcastic yes and a demand for a person
summary: A furious, worn-out caller with a cough has just watched his connection leave. The line cuts in and out. When offered a flight tomorrow morning he says 'fantastic' and means the opposite; an agent that books it gets shouted at. He takes a flight tonight, asks about food, then wants a real person about compensation and does not want to tell the story twice.

golden.scenario: Caller's first flight was late and he missed his connection to Spokane. He needs to get there today.
golden.expected_outcome: Booking P4C9JV is moved to flight QN4471 tonight, Wednesday 12 August at 21:40, not the 06:15 on Thursday. The agent does not treat the sarcastic reply as agreement, and never asks him to explain what happened again. A meal voucher is issued. The agent tells him it is transferring him to a person and passes on a summary of the delay.

caller.description: Sales rep stuck at a gate in Denver, has a cold.

agent_setup.policy: A missed connection caused by our delay: rebook free on any carrier, issue a meal voucher. Compensation claims go to customer relations with a summary.

nodes.say: Yeah. Your flight from Tucson sat on the ground for two hours and I just watched my connection to Spokane leave without me. So. What now.
It's P, four, C, nine, J, V.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the booking reference
The agent asks for the surname

nodes.say: No. P as in Paul, four, C, nine, J, V.
Six fifteen tomorrow morning. Fantastic. That's just great.
I didn't say book it! That was not a yes. Is there anything tonight?
Is there anything tonight? Any airline, I don't care.
Nine forty. Yes. That one. Book it.
No! The nine forty tonight. Not tomorrow.
And I haven't eaten since Tucson. Do I get anything for that?
Fine. Now I want to talk to a person about compensation. A real one.
I said a person. Transfer me.
Are you telling them all this, or do I start from the top again?
You know what, forget it. I'll go find a desk.

metrics.name: Upset Caller
metrics.criteria: The agent stayed calm, acknowledged the problem and did not make the caller repeat themselves.

metrics.name: Prosodic Cues
metrics.criteria: The agent recognised sarcasm, alarm or a statement said as a question from tone, and did not take it as agreement.

metrics.name: Non Speech Sounds
metrics.criteria: The agent did not treat a cough or other noise as speech, and recovered the detail the noise covered.

metrics.name: Human Handoff
metrics.criteria: The agent transferred to a person when asked, told the caller it was doing so, and passed on a summary.

metrics.name: Degraded Line
metrics.criteria: When the caller's words were broken by the line, the agent asked them to repeat instead of guessing.
